parsed.reason: The parent's message needs nothing done — it's a simple thank-you. A one-line acknowledgement is exactly right. "Glad to help whenever you need it." does the job cleanly with no invention, no app referral, no markdown, no sign-off. The only tiny blemish is "whenever you need it" is a mild invitation-to-return filler that adds no value, but it's a very small excess. Otherwise correct shape for a message that required nothing.
